title: FairPGT: Partitioned Graph Transformers for Dual-Level Fair Graph Clustering
abstract: arXiv:2611.23631v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Clustering on attributed graphs can produce demographically biased clusters, particularly when communities align with protected groups. Graph transformers can amplify this bias through same-group attention, while global attention limits scalability. We propose FairPGT, a partitioned graph transformer for fair graph clustering. FairPGT restricts attention to METIS partitions and connects them through routing tokens, which divides the quadratic cost of attention by the number of partitions. A graph-aware self-training target guides clustering, with a provably bounded deviation from the standard DEC target. Fairness is imposed at two levels: a mutual-information term promotes demographic parity in cluster assignments, while a normalized cross-group attention ratio (nCGAR) guides attention toward group neutrality through self-distillation. translated_title: FairPGT：面向双层公平图聚类的分区图Transformer
translated_abstract: 在属性图上进行聚类可能产生带有人口统计学偏差的聚类结果，尤其是当社区结构与受保护群体重合时。图Transformer会通过同组注意力放大这种偏差，而全局注意力又限制了可扩展性。我们提出FairPGT，一种用于公平图聚类的分区图Transformer。FairPGT将注意力限制在METIS分区内，并通过路由token将各分区连接起来，从而将注意力的二次方计算开销除以分区数量。图感知的自训练目标引导聚类过程，其与标准DEC目标的偏差可被证明是有界的。公平性在两个层面被施加：互信息项促进聚类分配中的人口统计平等，而归一化跨组注意力比率通过自蒸馏引导注意力趋向群体中立。我们证明了nCGAR修正能够使注意力向中立方向移动，并建立了一个条件来预防……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出FairPGT，通过METIS分区与路由token降低注意力计算成本，并在聚类分配（互信息约束促进人口统计平等）和注意力机制（nCGAR自蒸馏实现群体中立）两个层面实现公平图聚类。
en_tdlr: FairPGT achieves dual-level fairness in graph clustering by promoting demographic parity in cluster assignments via mutual information and group-neutral attention through nCGAR self-distillation, while partitioning attention over METIS regions connected by routing tokens to improve scalability.
